finding: A new user who chooses the CLI default for every tier can pass model resolution and then fail validation. Step 5 offers deletion for each placeholder row without mentioning what happens when the last row is gone. With only on_missing = auto in [facts], resolve-model exits 0 with empty output and matrix-lint exits 1 with MX-EMPTY. The linked reference explains MX-EMPTY. Add the validation consequence beside the deletion instructions in Step 5.
why_this_severity: The resolver still uses the requested default (no to fails_purpose). The reader has to consult the linked reference and configure a model row to pass validation.
